description: Loosely: fires in the middlegame (about 6-22 stones) when column 2 is completely empty while the centre (columns 3-5) holds stones, typically with my stone at the bottom of column 3 and column 1 also empty or low. Any stone in column 2 nearly always switches it off. Short openings and positions with many opponent stones in column 4 do not fire. This is only a partial, weak description (F1 ~0.3).
effect: None measurable: forcing it to its maximum or to zero changes every column's probability by at most 0.03 on 5 positions.
notes: Layer 2. Histograms: col 2 empty in 83-87% of top bands vs 27% at band 0. Minimal pairs: a col-2 stone kills it; tall stacks in cols 3-5 raise it; cols 0/1/6 stacks alone are negative; strongly nonlinear and ownership-dependent. Dev F1: p1 0.267, p2 0.291 (submitted), p3 0.301 (cell-points), p4 0.213, p5 0.220, p6 0.197; sim share <=0.07. Misses include col 2 tall with cols 0-1 or 3-4 empty. One score call was wasted by a duplicate run. Likely a mixture or random direction; no steering effect.
